verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Section 3.4.1 tie 8.08×10-5 S/cm (total ionic conductivity, room temperature) to the x=0.10 Ti sample (Li7La3Zr1.9Ti0.1O12), and Table 2 aligns it with 0.10. The 0.37 eV activation energy, 1100 °C sintering for 8 h, and 91.8% relative density are all stated for this sample, and the room-temperature value has no numeric temperature so null is correct.
